key_claims.claim: In 70 prenatally diagnosed closed spinal dysraphism cases over 10 years, limited dorsal myeloschisis was the predominant subtype, with functional outcomes documented at 18 and 36 months.

The ClinGen Prenatal Gene Curation Expert Panel systematically curated 61 genes across 63 disease relationships for severe prenatal phenotypes, establishing an evidence-based framework for prenatal genomic counseling.
Opportunistic genetic testing during fetoscopic laser for TTTS is feasible with 78% uptake, though clinically significant abnormalities were detected in only a small fraction of cases.
Fetal intracranial hemorrhage has heterogeneous etiologies including FNAIT, COL4A1/2 variants, and infections, with neurodevelopmental outcomes varying by classification and underlying cause.
Among 212 isolated pelvic kidney fetuses, CMA diagnostic yield was 0.5%, with trio exome adding modest yield and KMT2D being the most clinically attributable gene.
